# Guide

## Prerequisites

- [buf](https://docs.buf.build/installation)

## Generate

```sh
buf generate
```

## Format

```sh
buf format -w
```

# Memos API Design

This API design should follow the guidelines and best practices outlined in the [Google API Improvement Proposals (AIPs)](https://google.aip.dev/).

message.text: The public API is defined via proto/gRPC/Connect/REST using grpc-gateway. No GraphQL schema exists.

r05.
There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is protobuf gRPC (AIP-style) under `proto/api/v1/` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, and the other `*_service.proto` files). Generated Connect and gRPC-Gateway handlers expose Connect/gRPC plus REST (`server/router/api/v1/`, `proto/gen/api/v1/`). The README calls this REST and gRPC, not GraphQL.
